description: Compare first. Share later. **PicDiff** is for people who care about small visual details. It lets you compare the original images you selected locally in your browser, so you can check changes before anything gets uploaded or turned into a web-friendly version. Why people use it - Review screenshots, design revisions, game captures, before-and-after edits, and AI-generated image variations - Switch between **side-by-side, slider, fade, diff, single-view, and blink** - Zoom and pan in sync when
